title: Read measured house references
command: Read {plugin_dir}/reference/reconstruction.md and inspect every image in {image}. Write house-spec.json in {workspace} using the evidence contract in {plugin_dir}/reference/evidence.md.

title: Build procedural architectural assemblies
command: Use {spec} to build named roof, envelope, porch and interior assemblies in {workspace}. Render cardinal directions and overhead; fix footprint, openings and roof intersections before materials.

title: Exercise the real house experience
command: Run the website in {workspace}. Capture actual browser views and interaction checks, hash current sources and PNG evidence, then write .img2/artifacts/house/browser-qa.json according to {plugin_dir}/reference/evidence.md.
